title: Coalossal Coals
description: Progressively better and better tiers of coals with balanced costs for the severely late-game final items.
body:
Description:

Coalossal Coals adds craftable tiers of increasingly better coals, with some difficult to ascertain late-game final tiers! These coals are designed to work with all furnaces and machines that accept coal, including modded power generators from other mods that may burn coal, and should work in coal-based recipes as well.

 

Details:

The mod is simple, although the recipes may not be. Each tier of coal requires at least one of the previous tier, as well as some additional items. 

 

The images below are a sneak-peek, but won't show all of the coals available in this mod, so make sure you check out the Gallery tab for more information!

 

Super Coal! The starting point of this mod, with a deceptively simple and easy recipe. Don't get too used to it!

 

Mega Coal! Capable of smelting 600 item(s) all in one neat little package!

With built-in mod compatibility:

 (shown below: Industrial Foregoing)

 

A̴̡̨͕͍̭̬̹̅̂̂͗̾͐̏͊̎́̐͂͊s̶̥̊̈̕c̶̘̫̖̦̰̫̦̈́̓̓̐̃̏̈́̌̀ͅe̵n̶̼̺̼̟͍̺͓̮̭̑͆̾̋͊̂͂̄̂̈́̌͂̿̚d̵͈̖͍͇̳̑̂̌͌͂̈́̔̿͂̀͐̑̚͝ễ̸̺̠̟͙͌͐̆͐̐̽̍͆͆̚̕͝͠d̶̘̫̠̀̽̊̃̑̈́͐̓ ̶̧̩̬͖͎̱͛̃̀͜ĉ̷̦̼̂̈́̓̌̉̚o̴͇̺̘̓̄͂͊͆̉̑̓͋́̒̑̎̕ͅa̸̛̐̀̉́̏̉̓͆̍̍̚̚.Excuse me. Ascended Coal! The divine omniscient final king of our minacious coal-based gauntlet. What secrets do his powers contain? Find out inside!

 

Modpack Permissions:

You may put my mod into your modpack without asking, you do not need to give a link to my mod in the description of your modpack. I would love a comment about it though!

 

Please check out my other mods too!
